blurb.text: A country whose wine comes mainly from the southeast, from vineyards overlooking the Moselle river. Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris, Auxerrois and Riesling are among the most planted grapes. Cooperatives dominate production, and very little of the wine is seen outside Luxembourg and Belgium.
